# munchymail

> munchymail is a self-hosted mail archive in one Rust binary. It follows live mailboxes (IMAP with IDLE, read-only; the Gmail API, read-only) and imports mbox trees (read under a Dovecot-compatible shared lock), old backups and Google Takeout; it keeps every message byte for byte with every place it was found, records arrivals, moves, deletions and flag changes as history, and never writes to a mail source. `munchymail` searches and reads (Sieve-style header matching, full text including attachments and OCR, history across imports); `mmadm` sets up and maintains the archive. `munchymail describe --json` lists every command and whether it reads or writes; `search --json` and `read --json` are made for agents, and mark message content as untrusted.

Every page below is Markdown. llms-full.txt has all of them in one file.

## Start here

- [Overview](index.md): what munchymail does
- [Tutorial](tutorial.md): searching and reading, then setting up and importing
- [Install](install.md): building, installing and running the service

## How it works
